map.估算光伏发电量对应的减排效益。: Estimate the emission-reduction benefit of solar PV generation.
map.📖 查看「光伏减排估算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "PV Emission Reduction Estimation Guide"
map.年发电量 = 装机 × 满发小时: Annual generation = installed capacity × full-load hours
map.等效植树按每棵年吸收 18kg CO₂ 估算。: Equivalent trees are estimated at 18 kg CO₂ absorbed per tree per year.
map.📚 深度解析：光伏减排估算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: PV Emission Reduction Estimation
map.户用光伏：录入装机 kW 与年等效利用小时，求年发电与节省电费/减排。: Household PV: enter the installed kW and annual equivalent utilisation hours to obtain annual generation, bill savings and emission reduction.
map.减排核算：按发电量×电网排放因子得年 CO2 减排量，用于绿证/碳核算。: Reduction accounting: generation × grid emission factor gives the annual CO₂ reduction, used for green certificates or carbon accounting.
map.教学演示：演示资源区（等效小时）对发电量的主导影响。: Teaching demo: show how the resource zone (equivalent hours) dominates generation.
map.示例：10 kW、年等效 1200 h、系统效率 0.8，年发电≈10×1200: Example: 10 kW, 1200 equivalent hours per year and a system efficiency of 0.8 gives annual generation ≈ 10×1200×0.8 = 9600 kWh and a reduction of ≈ 9600×0.58 ≈ 5.6 tCO₂.
map.全年理论满功率发电时长，反映资源优劣（如三类资源区约 1000–1300 h）。: The theoretical hours of full-power generation in a year, reflecting resource quality (about 1000–1300 h in a class-III resource zone). Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.系统效率为何乘？: Why multiply by the system efficiency?
map.组件衰降、线损、逆变与遮挡使实际发电低于理论，乘性能比(约 0.75–0.85): Module degradation, line losses, inverter losses and shading make actual generation lower than theoretical, so a performance ratio of about 0.75–0.85 is applied. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.用项目所在电网平均排放因子（约 0.5–0.6 kgCO₂/kWh），以官方公布: Use the average emission factor of the grid where the project is located (about 0.5–0.6 kgCO₂/kWh), following official publications. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
